procedures.name: despawn_actor
procedures.notes: Finds the actor by script ID, switches it to actor state 6, and runs its update callback.

procedures.name: set_actor_heading
procedures.notes: Resolves actor_id and writes value as the actor's heading angle at offset 0x74. In stage mode 9 the handler delegates to the stage callback table.

procedures.name: move_actor
procedures.notes: Sets the actor movement target. A negative high-bit form is interpreted by the handler as a duration; the ordinary form is movement speed.

procedures.name: set_actor_property
procedures.notes: Returns the previous property value.

procedures.name: change_item_count
procedures.notes: Adds or removes inventory quantity with the engine's item-specific cap and returns whether the inventory changed.

procedures.name: get_item_count
procedures.notes: Reads the inventory quantity byte at global state offset 0xEAD + item_id.

procedures.name: select_party_member
procedures.notes: Pushes the current party-member entry and changes the active party member/mode from the argument; values above 9 are normalized by the handler.

procedures.name: register_input_value
procedures.notes: Checks the eight-byte input-value table at global offset 0xE9D and inserts input_value into the first empty slot. Returns the handler's status (already present/full or zero after insertion).

procedures.name: set_actor_orientation
procedures.notes: Operations 0-3 assign/add actor heading fields; operation 4 writes a scaled orientation-related field.

procedures.name: set_event_sound_bit
procedures.notes: Sets one bit in the per-character/event sound flag table at global offset 0x2D8; the packed argument is (table_index << 8) | bit.

procedures.name: create_script_record
procedures.notes: Allocates the first free entry in the 200-record script table, marks it active (for keys 0..99), initializes its fields, and consumes eight arguments. The record is later consumed by field/effect update handlers.

procedures.name: allocate_resource_instance
procedures.notes: Finds a loaded resource by key, allocates one of 32 script resource-instance records, and returns its pointer-like handle or zero.

procedures.name: release_resource_instance
procedures.notes: Marks a nonzero script resource-instance handle as state 3 for release.

procedures.name: create_script_record_variant
procedures.notes: Allocates a script-table entry with status 3 and fills the record's key, resource/value fields, and six short parameters. This is the non-active companion to create_script_record.

procedures.name: set_effect_setting
procedures.notes: Updates one of the engine's effect settings. Selectors set mode, position, primary/secondary color, a field byte, or a rotation-derived position; -1 selects the shared settings record and -2 the global record.

procedures.name: audio_command
procedures.notes: Dispatches an audio-system command. -2 and -3 select engine-wide audio actions, 0x61 uses a dedicated path, and all other values are forwarded as an audio resource/command ID.

procedures.name: set_audio_fade
procedures.notes: Clamps the limit to the global audio cap, scales amount, and submits an audio command with selector 0xFD. Selector 1 can suppress the call from global state.

procedures.name: play_sound_simple
procedures.notes: Plays a sound with the global channel/color and a centered, clamped velocity derived from raw_velocity.

procedures.name: request_field_transition
procedures.notes: Stores the requested field/resource ID, current stage mode, and transition flag, then switches the script state to the field-transition state.

procedures.name: change_music
procedures.notes: Stops music when music_id is -1; otherwise resolves the music resource and starts a fade/transition when the current stage permits it.

procedures.name: finish_actor_action
procedures.notes: Stores action_id in the script state, enters substate 0x1A, and enables the current target actor's interaction flags when a prior action is being finalized.

procedures.name: disable_mapped_input
procedures.notes: Sets the global flag that makes mapped-input queries return zero unless their bypass bit is set.

procedures.name: is_mapped_input_disabled
procedures.notes: Returns the mapped-input disable flag.

procedures.name: set_transition_mode
procedures.notes: Consumes a mode and amount and updates the global fade/transition interpolation state. Modes 0..5 select fade direction, sentinel behavior, or a timer callback.
procedures.arity_evidence: fn_8004E260 consumes duration then mode; title event 3000 passes (0,240).

procedures.name: yield_command
procedures.notes: The handler pops value first and command second; source argument order is command, value.

procedures.name: random_mod
procedures.notes: Returns the engine PRNG value modulo divisor.

procedures.name: show_choice
procedures.notes: Configures the active dialogue slot as a line-range choice and returns the selected 1-based line.

procedures.name: set_scenario_timer
procedures.notes: Writes two timer bytes and the current stage byte into the scenario timer table and records the current OS time for timer_id (0..200).

procedures.name: adjust_character_affinity
procedures.notes: Adds delta to the character relation/affinity field at global character record offset 0x1F8, clamps it to [-10000,10000], and returns the new value.

procedures.name: set_global_eab_eac
procedures.notes: Returns the old byte at global offset 0xEAB and, unless value_eab is -1, writes bytes 0xEAB and 0xEAC.

procedures.name: discard_value
procedures.notes: Pops one value from the VM argument stack; the handler has no game-side effect.

procedures.name: set_dialogue_slot_flag
procedures.notes: For an active dialogue slot, operation 0 controls flag 0x0002 and operation 1 controls flag 0x0020.

procedures.name: start_encounter
procedures.notes: Selects encounter metadata, begins battle mode 0x0B, and yields with command 27. When skip_if_loaded is false, an already loaded encounter is ignored.

procedures.name: snapshot_input_state
procedures.notes: Operation 0 copies eight global input bytes from 0xE9D..0xEA4 to 0x1F34..0x1F3B; operation 1 clears the destination bytes.

procedures.name: get_scenario_timer_value
procedures.notes: Returns the first timer byte for timer_id from the scenario timer table (0..200), or zero when out of range.

procedures.name: stage_command
procedures.notes: Dispatches a command through the active stage callback table in stage mode 9 and returns zero. Command selectors 0 through 10 are handled.

procedures.name: stage_command_44
procedures.notes: Calls active-stage callback table offset 0x44 in mode 9 and returns zero.

procedures.name: resolve_script_resource
procedures.notes: Decomposes a packed resource identifier, resolves it for the active stage mode, and returns an encoded signed resource handle.

procedures.name: release_script_resource
procedures.notes: Releases encoded resources in the 0xFFFFxxxx handle family and returns zero.

procedures.name: configure_actor_animation
procedures.notes: Selects an actor animation/resource source and configures its duration/frame and flags. Resource ID -1 selects data attached to the actor or stage.

procedures.name: set_actor_animation_property
procedures.notes: Reads or exchanges selector-dependent animation timing fields on the actor's animation object and returns the previous value.

procedures.name: select_camera
procedures.notes: Returns the previous camera selection. Selectors -1 and -2 invoke special camera modes.

procedures.name: set_camera_property
procedures.notes: Exchanges a selector-dependent camera property and returns its prior value.

procedures.name: set_camera_transition_values
procedures.notes: Writes four floating-point transition values to the selected camera and activates it.

procedures.name: select_actor
procedures.notes: Resolves actor_id and marks it as the active interaction target, clearing the target-selection latch when the target changes.

procedures.name: configure_camera_parameters
procedures.notes: Writes six paired fields at camera offsets 0x64..0x90 and two global camera values. The engine's float-zero sentinel leaves individual fields unchanged.

procedures.name: configure_camera_auxiliary
procedures.notes: Configures the camera-adjacent structure at lbl_802C8700; mode selects internal state 0 or 5, followed by two float and three byte fields.

procedures.name: measure_actor_geometry
procedures.notes: Returns geometry between two actors: operation 0 is heading angle, 1 horizontal distance, 2 vertical delta, and 3 three-dimensional distance.

procedures.name: set_actor_mode
procedures.notes: Writes actor mode byte 0xC4; selectors 2 through 17 also write submode byte 0xC7.

procedures.name: set_actor_behavior
procedures.notes: Writes the actor behavior mode byte at offset 0xCA; behavior values 2..9 select submodes 0..7 at offset 0xCD.

procedures.name: attach_actor_to_member
procedures.notes: Copies a member's resource/owner value into the actor link fields; member_index -1 clears the link.

procedures.name: read_mapped_input
procedures.notes: Returns a mapped controller/input bitfield for one of four player rows. The low nibble selects the mapping table.

procedures.name: find_actor_animation
procedures.notes: Looks up the actor animation resource selected by animation_resource_slot and returns the matching animation index, or -1 if no actor/resource is available.

procedures.name: configure_actor_attachment
procedures.notes: Configures one actor attachment/part through fn_8006C660 using a part index, position vector, and scale.

procedures.name: configure_actor_head_neck
procedures.notes: Configures the Bone_kubi and Bone_atama actor parts through fn_8006C660 with a shared position and scale.

procedures.name: set_actor_animation
procedures.notes: Resolves actor_id and selects animation_id through the actor animation object; loop_or_mode chooses the looping or one-shot setter.

procedures.name: stage_command_54
procedures.notes: Calls active-stage callback table offset 0x54 in mode 9, swapping the first two source arguments, and returns zero.

procedures.name: set_effect_property
procedures.notes: Sets one property of an effect/object handle. Properties 120..149 cover position, color, scale, rotation, flags, and byte parameters; the call returns zero.

procedures.name: create_effect_object
procedures.notes: Allocates and initializes a field effect/object through fn_800830BC, writes its transform, scale, duration, layer, rotation, and flags, and returns the object handle.

procedures.name: motion_command
procedures.notes: Controls the VM's persistent motion state: actor position/rotation targets, interpolation speed or frame durations, scalar values, saved integers, and geometry queries (operation 0..19).

procedures.name: configure_input_binding
procedures.notes: Updates the controller binding table: operation 100 sets a digital binding, 101 sets an analog binding, and 102 clears a binding.

procedures.name: run_resource_callback
procedures.notes: Invokes the resource/cache setup callback for resource_handle and pops the handle from the VM stack.
